_maintainer_note: The curated list of knowledge packs the BuildBot wizard offers first, before it searches the wider Kiwix library (config/catalog_index.json). Adding a row is granting a download, not filing a bookmark. Rules: (1) LICENSE IS MANDATORY. A row with no 'license' and 'license_url' is never offered and never fetched - the loader drops it and records a config-health defect naming the id. Read the license page before adding a row and record the date in 'license_checked'. (2) NC MEANS NC. NonCommercial rows carry 'commercial_use': false and the wizard says 'personal use only' out loud. (3) KIWIX ROWS NAME THE BOOK, NOT AN ADDRESS. A Kiwix row carries 'kiwix_book' (and 'kiwix_flavour' when the library lists more than one). The library reissues books under new dated file names, so a fixed address goes dead (all eight did by 2026-09-23). At download time the fetcher asks the library for the newest issue of that book, reads its .meta4 file, follows a redirect only to a mirror that .meta4 names, and checks the bytes against the SHA-256 in it: 'pin': 'kiwix_meta4'. A row that is not a Kiwix book must carry a fixed https 'source_url' and a 'sha256' the maintainer measured; a moving address (a branch name, a '/latest/') cannot be pinned and does not go in. (4) size_mb IS THE REAL SIZE of the current issue in MB, read from the library listing (2026-09-23). It is shown before any download; a reissue more than half again as big is refused rather than silently downloaded. (5) ONLY THINGS THIS BUILD CAN LEARN FROM. Every row here is a pack the knowledge indexer reads. Landing pages and API catalogs (NASA's api.nasa.gov, the Astropy docs index, MedlinePlus) were removed on 2026-09-23 because nothing indexed them; live data belongs to the live-data catalog, not here. 'Where There Is No Doctor' was removed the same day because the Kiwix library no longer lists it. (6) TAGS ARE THE MATCHING SURFACE. A row is proposed only when one of its tags or a word of its label appears in what the person typed, and the proposal cites that word. Filler words can never match, so do not use them as tags. (7) FETCHED CONTENT IS DATA, FOREVER. Nothing downloaded is ever placed in a prompt as instruction. (8) Kiwix files are read by our own reader; kiwix-serve is never used. HONEST LIMIT: the Kiwix library is broad, not deep. Say the gap out loud; do not paper over it.
